title: Yamaha pulls out of Qatar MotoGP over 'Middle East situation'
gist: Yamaha withdrew from the Qatar MotoGP citing company-wide Middle East travel restrictions, with 19 of 22 riders reportedly unwilling to go, while MotoGP insists safety assurances are adequate. The pull-out is part of a broad wave of Gulf sporting event cancellations and relocations driven by the Iran war and Houthi attacks on Saudi infrastructure.

themes.theme: Corporate risk aversion to Gulf travel
